title: Interview: Sales queue assignment and voice capacity
story: You meet Aisha, the contact centre manager for Contoso sales. She wants to improve how incoming sales calls are handled.
Talk with her to find the changes she needs. Then build the changes in the simulated environment.

interview.opening: We need fewer dropped or delayed sales calls and less agent burnout.

topics.ask: What problem do you see with how calls are handed to agents now?
topics.answer: Sometimes busy agents get more calls while others sit idle. We want calls given to agents who have the most free capacity.

topics.ask: How should the system choose who gets the next call?
topics.answer: Prefer agents who have the lightest load so work is spread fairly and faster for customers.

topics.ask: Do you want agents to take more than one voice work item at a time?
topics.answer: Yes. We need agents to handle a few voice items so callbacks and transfers don't block the queue. Three would be ideal.

extras.ask: Are peak hours different for sales this quarter?
extras.answer: Yes, mornings are busier, but that doesn't change the need for fair assignment.

extras.ask: Will agents need extra training for this change?
extras.answer: A short briefing will help, but the change should be mostly technical.
